name: The University of Osaka
summary: National university in Osaka, founded 1931; its Human Sciences international degree is taught in English, with October 2027 entry.

handoff.label: Special English entrance examinations and programs

ib.text: The IB Diploma is a listed qualification and predicted grades are accepted; offers can be conditional on IB results sent in July. An IB English A1 (SL or HL) or English B HL at grade 4 or above counts as English proof.

apply.via: Human Sciences online registration, plus documents by post

dates.label: Online registration and application fee deadline, 23:59 JST
Application documents must arrive by post
Deadline to reply to an offer by email

programmes.name: Human Sciences International Undergraduate Degree Program
programmes.about: An English-medium degree from the School of Human Sciences with a small intake. After foundation courses you focus on Diversity and Inclusion Studies, Japan Studies, or Political and Global Studies, ending in a fourth-year thesis.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of transcripts, test scores, a 700-word personal statement and two recommendation letters; some applicants are interviewed between mid-February and mid-March 2027.

notes: Accelerated graduation after 3.5 years is possible for students who meet the academic criteria.
Osaka's International Undergraduate Program in Science runs a six-month Japanese course from October 2027, is partly in Japanese, and starts in April 2028, so it is not listed here.
The old Chemistry-Biology Combined Major Program no longer accepts applications.
